pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-edged polygonal regions with jagged, high-frequency perimeter gradients. Patches exhibit internal 'starburst' patterns where the dark pigment is less saturated in linear paths radiating from the center.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, interconnected cream-colored network forming a high-density topological graph. Nodes typically occur at the intersection of three to four pathways. Pathway pixel thickness is relatively uniform but narrows at junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, jagged 1D silhouette is visible along the upper neck, created by the vertical projection of mane hairs against the background foliage.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized, high-contrast white patch of depigmentation is present on the posterior flank near the rump, indicating a site of healed physical trauma or scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Two red-billed birds (Buphagus species) are visible perched on the dorsal ridge—one on the upper neck and one near the shoulder blades.
